events.name: Zimbabwe v Australia
events.recapText: Travis Head made 112 from 84 balls as Australia posted 6/356. That batting platform secured an unassailable 2–0 series lead, although Billy Stanlake’s injury interrupted his return.

events.outcomeText: Australia defeated Zimbabwe by one wicket.
events.recapText: Nathan Ellis and Spencer Johnson added an unbeaten 27 for the last wicket, completing the chase with one ball remaining. Josh Inglis had made a century before the tail finished the job, sealing a 3–0 series sweep.
